method: Built-in image_gen; original visual sprites. Deterministic extraction only; no code-drawn replacement artwork.

entries.name: customer_student
entries.walkPrompt:
Create a production-ready PIXEL ART WALK ANIMATION SHEET of ONE new customer for the same top-down parcel shop game as the reference. Reference images are STYLE ONLY; the new identity must be a young East Asian male university student, short fluffy dark-brown hair, round black glasses, mustard-yellow hoodie, dark navy trousers, white trainers with brown soles, small plain dark-brown backpack on his back. NOT a clerk uniform. Empty hands in EVERY sprite, relaxed arms swing. Match reference exactly: compact 2.5-head chibi proportions, thick dark outlines, chunky square pixel clusters, simple readable shading, small faces, limited colors, slightly elevated orthographic top-down view. NOT painterly, not smooth illustration, not isometric. Artwork must still read clearly when a whole figure is reduced to about 24 x 40 pixels.

EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS = 32 separate full-body frames on perfectly solid flat #00FF00 green. No green clothing. Each row is one coherent eight-frame walk cycle of the SAME character, SAME outfit, SAME scale. Row1 faces DOWN/front toward viewer; Row2 faces LEFT/profile; Row3 faces RIGHT/profile; Row4 faces UP/back away. Do not repeat front view in the back row. Within EACH row, columns are chronological: 1 left contact wide stride; 2 down; 3 passing feet close underneath body; 4 up; 5 opposite right contact wide stride; 6 down; 7 opposite passing feet close; 8 up. Strong visible alternation of feet, genuine walking not eight idle copies. Legs remain attached and natural. Keep face/hair/clothing absolutely consistent across all32. Every entire head, hat/backpack if any, hands and shoe stays inside its own equal-sized cell with generous green gutters, stable floor baseline and no overlap. No text, no gridlines, no labels, no borders, no props, no parcel, no ground shadow, no scenery. Landscape sheet.

entries.carryPrompt:
Create a matching PIXEL ART PARCEL-CARRY WALK ANIMATION SHEET for the EXACT blue-hat customer shown in FIRST reference: same adult East Asian woman, sky-blue bucket hat, navy bob hair, pale-blue jacket and cream top, dark charcoal wide lower garment, white sneakers. The SECOND reference is ONLY the existing game's two-handed parcel pose and pixel style. Keep FIRST reference's character identity and outfit; do NOT turn her into red-jacket customer. She holds ONE medium brown cardboard parcel steadily with BOTH hands in front of her waist/chest in EVERY frame. Parcel has blank cream label, same size in every frame, both hands actually touch it. In back view parcel is correctly hidden in front of torso, no parcel on back. Empty-hands body from first reference becomes holding arms; legs do genuine smooth eight-frame walking.
EXACTLY8 COLUMNS x4 ROWS=32 full-body pixel sprites, one character, flat pure #00FF00 green background. Row1 DOWN/front, row2 LEFT/profile, row3 RIGHT/profile, row4 UP/back. Each row eight chronological walk phases: left contact wide, down, passing narrow, up, right contact wide, down, opposite passing narrow, up. Column3 and7 feet close underneath body;1 and5 visibly opposite wide strides. Match FIRST reference's silhouette, consistent scale and pixel density in every cell. Chunky square pixel clusters, dark crisp outlines, no anti-alias, simple small face, compact 2.5-head top-down RPG proportions, legible at32x48. Not painterly, not isometric. Exact uniform grid with generous green gutters, full head, hat, parcel and all shoes inside each cell, stable floor baseline. No text, labels, gridlines, border, drop shadow or scenery.
